exclusion_detail: Lead 27g is made through the pyrimidine core 24g, the side chain 19, 25g and 26g; the Experimental states these were 'synthesized according to the published literature [29-32]' and gives no procedure for them, so the route is not explicit. It would also be 5 reactions (Biginelli, amide formation of 19, substitution, POCl3 chlorination, thiolate substitution), over the 4-step limit.

lead.label: 27g
lead.why: Abstract: 'compound 27g showed the best antiproliferative activity on MGC-803 cells' and was used for the mechanism studies.

notes: Only the last step (22a-af from 21, 27a-j from 26) has a procedure. No SI in bundle. The substituent of 27g was not transcribed.
